title: Quantitative mapping from conventional MRI using self-supervised physics-guided deep learning: applications to a large-scale, clinically heterogeneous dataset
abstract: arXiv:2601.05063v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is a cornerstone of clinical neuroimaging, yet conventional MRIs provide qualitative information heavily dependent on scanner hardware and acquisition settings. While quantitative MRI (qMRI) offers intrinsic tissue parameters, the requirement for specialized acquisition protocols and reconstruction algorithms restricts its availability and impedes large-scale biomarker research. This study presents a self-supervised physics-guided deep learning framework to infer quantitative T1, T2, and proton-density (PD) maps directly from widely available clinical conventional T1-weighted, T2-weighted, and FLAIR MRIs. The framework was trained and evaluated on a large-scale, clinically heterogeneous dataset comprising 4,121 scan sessions acquired at our institution over six years on four different 3 T MRI scanner systems, capturing real-world clinical variability. translated_title: 基于自监督物理引导深度学习的常规MRI定量映射：应用于大规模临床异质性数据集
translated_abstract: 磁共振成像（MRI）是临床神经影像学的基石，然而常规MRI提供的信息是定性的，严重依赖于扫描硬件和采集设置。虽然定量MRI（qMRI）能提供内在的组织参数，但其对专门采集协议和重建算法的需求限制了其可用性，并阻碍了大规模生物标志物研究。本研究提出了一种自监督物理引导的深度学习框架，可直接从广泛可用的临床常规T1加权、T2加权和FLAIR MRI中推断出定量的T1、T2和质子密度（PD）图。该框架在一个大规模、临床异质性数据集上进行了训练和评估，该数据集包含在我们机构六年内使用四种不同的3T MRI扫描系统采集的4,121次扫描会话，捕捉了真实世界的临床变异性。该框架整合了基于Bloch的信号模型。
tldr: 本研究提出一种自监督物理引导深度学习框架，能从常规临床MRI中直接生成定量T1、T2和PD图，并在大规模异质性临床数据上验证其有效性。
en_tdlr: This study presents a self-supervised physics-guided deep learning framework that directly generates quantitative T1, T2, and PD maps from conventional clinical MRI, validated on a large-scale heterogeneous clinical dataset.
